# CrowAgent

> CrowAgent helps UK suppliers find the work, draft answers grounded in their own past bids, and evidence delivery after award. CrowMark serves both sides of a procurement, the supplier responding and the buyer reading responses, in the public and private sector. The pages below are plain explainers and free tools, cited to the underlying legislation and procurement policy notes.

## Products

- [CrowMark for Suppliers](https://crowagent.ai/crowmark): Respond to tenders, RFPs, RFIs, PQQs and SQs in the public and private sector. Daily tender discovery from Contracts Finder and Find a Tender, answers drafted from the supplier's own submitted bids, figures checked in code rather than generated, PPN 002 social value at the 10% minimum weighting, PPN 017 AI disclosure, and commitments tracked against delivery under Procurement Act 2023 s.52. From £49/month.
- [CrowMark for Buyers](https://crowagent.ai/crowmark#buyers): Build and publish requirements with a deterministic social value rubric, then locate the evidence for each requirement across every response received. Every quote is grounded verbatim in the supplier's own text and dropped if it cannot be located, so nothing is invented. It locates and organises and NEVER scores: the evaluation panel scores, which is what Procurement Act 2023 equal treatment requires. After award, delivery is tracked against what was promised.

## Free tools

- [Tools hub](https://crowagent.ai/tools): Free procurement checks for UK bid teams, cited to the underlying policy. No account required.
- [PPN 002 social value calculator](https://crowagent.ai/tools/ppn-002-calculator): Score a UK public-sector bid against the mandatory 10% social-value floor, cited to National TOMs and Oxford SVB proxies.
- [PPN 002 calculator methodology](https://crowagent.ai/tools/ppn-002-calculator/methodology): How the PPN 002 social-value score is computed.

## Procurement guides

- [PPN 002 social value: complete guide](https://crowagent.ai/blog/ppn-002-social-value-guide): What PPN 002 requires, the five themes, and how buyers score social value with National TOMs at a 10% minimum weighting.
- [The Procurement Act 2023 for SME bidders](https://crowagent.ai/blog/procurement-act-2023-sme-guide): What changed from 24 Feb 2025: MAT replaces MEAT, the Central Digital Platform and Find a Tender, s.52 KPIs on contracts over £5m, and what it means day-to-day for SMEs.
- [How to find and win your first UK public sector contract](https://crowagent.ai/blog/find-first-public-sector-contract): Where to look (Find a Tender vs Contracts Finder), how to read a tender, SQ vs ITT, the bid/no-bid decision, and PPN 002 social value.
- [How to write a method statement that actually scores](https://crowagent.ai/blog/method-statement-that-scores): Structure, evidence and risk content that earns marks in a UK tender quality response, and the common mistakes that cost them.
- [Frameworks and DPS explained](https://crowagent.ai/blog/frameworks-and-dps-explained): What a framework agreement and a Dynamic Purchasing System are, how Crown Commercial Service and G-Cloud work, and how call-off competitions are run.
- [Responding to corporate RFPs and PQQs in the private sector](https://crowagent.ai/blog/private-sector-rfp-pqq-guide): How private sector procurement differs from public tenders, what a PQQ checks outside government, and what corporate buyers actually score.
- [Blog index](https://crowagent.ai/blog/): All CrowAgent procurement guides and updates.

## Comparisons

- [Compare CrowMark](https://crowagent.ai/compare): Honest, sourced head-to-heads of CrowMark against the UK bid tools suppliers shortlist, with published pricing and a dated source for every competitor figure.
- [CrowMark vs AutogenAI](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-autogenai): SME bid suite with published pricing from £49/month against an enterprise engine that quotes on request.
- [CrowMark vs mytender.io](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-mytender-io): Figure-grounding and published pricing against a UK private-cloud drafting platform.
- [CrowMark vs CleanTender](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-cleantender): Sector-agnostic bid suite against a soft facilities-management specialist; both publish pricing.
- [CrowMark vs SwiftBid](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-swiftbid): Subscription suite from £49/month against a per-bid AI writing service, with the break-even worked through.
- [Social Value Portal vs CrowMark](https://crowagent.ai/blog/social-value-portal-vs-crowmark): How CrowMark compares to the Social Value Portal for UK suppliers.
